The background contains faint, illegible script and symbols that resemble text but are nonsensical, typical of AI-generated backgrounds attempting to mimic documents or maps.
The shadow cast by the ball is somewhat soft and diffuse, but the contact point between the ball and the surface is slightly ambiguous, lacking a sharp occlusion boundary.
